Chapter 145: Carrying Xixi Home on His Back

During Friday's evening self-study, after the second class ended.

Li Luo finished all his weekend homework, packed his schoolbag, and stood up from his seat.

This time, he didn't wait for Ying Chanxi to come downstairs to find him to go home together. Instead, after confirming there was nothing else he needed to take home, he left his bag in the classroom and walked straight upstairs.

Li Luo arrived at the doorway of Class One, glanced inside, and saw Ying Chanxi sitting obediently at her desk. Seeing him approach, she gave him a little wave.

"Let's go then."

Li Luo walked over to her desk and helped Ying Chanxi to her feet.

Under everyone's watchful eyes, the two of them left from Ying Chanxi's seat and slowly walked out of the classroom.

Since everyone knew that Li Luo was Ying Chanxi's cousin, no one thought much of it.

But when Li Luo and Ying Chanxi reached the top of the stairs, Ying Chanxi stopped and whispered, "Walking too much makes my knee hurt."

Li Luo glanced at her, sighed, and crouched down in front of Ying Chanxi, facing away from her with his arms outstretched. "Hurry up, stop dawdling."

Ying Chanxi wasn't one to dawdle. The moment she saw Li Luo crouch down, she felt like her foot didn't even hurt anymore. She pounced, wrapping her arms around Li Luo's neck.

Li Luo instinctively supported her thighs, and to save some energy, he even shifted her up a bit.

Feeling the warmth from Li Luo's palms, Ying Chanxi, on his back, blushed slightly but didn't say anything to stop him. She simply accepted his actions and whispered in his ear, "Be careful going down the stairs. Take it slow, don't fall."

"I know, just don't move around."

Feeling the petite figure on his back and the softness in his hands, Li Luo's heart still stirred a little.

But he quickly composed himself, took a deep breath, and walked step by step from the fourth floor down to the first.

It was a good thing he had been training his stamina with Yan Zhusheng every day recently. Otherwise, after just running 3000 meters this evening, his legs would have probably given out from carrying a whole person downstairs now.

After reaching Houde Road, Li Luo and Ying Chanxi met up with Xu Youyu, who had been waiting for a while.

Seeing Li Luo carrying Ying Chanxi on his back, Xu Youyu blinked, then looked at the crutch in her hand and was lost in thought for a moment.

Li Luo was also a bit stunned. Looking at the crutch in Xu Youyu's hand, he couldn't help but ask, "Where did you get that crutch?"

"A senior from the third year also injured her leg a while back and had been using a crutch to get to school. Her leg just healed recently, and she left the crutch in the classroom," Xu Youyu explained. "That senior used to be in the literature club and knows me pretty well, so I borrowed it from her. It's perfect for Xixi to use."

Hearing Xu Youyu say this, Ying Chanxi suddenly felt a little embarrassed.

She wanted to stay on Li Luo's back for a little longer.

But Xu Youyu had already been so thoughtful. It would be a bit unreasonable for her not to use the crutch.

But Li Luo just smiled, gave Ying Chanxi on his back a little bounce to hoist her up, and then said, "Just hold on to the crutch for now. When I get tired of carrying her, Xixi can use it."

"That works too." Xu Youyu nodded, carrying the crutch as she walked beside them.

Ying Chanxi's heart filled with joy. She tried her best to keep her lips from smiling, tightened her grip around Li Luo's neck, and buried her face in the crook of his shoulder.

From Houde Road all the way to the school gate, and from the school gate all the way to the entrance of the Bihai Lanting Residential Complex, Li Luo carried her into the elevator before finally putting her down.

Taking the crutch from Xu Youyu and trying it out, Ying Chanxi leaned on it as she walked out of the elevator and carefully made her way back to the door of Apartment 1502.

Having successfully brought the injured Ying Chanxi home, Li Luo's task was complete. He went straight back to his bedroom, preparing to take a shower and then write.

Meanwhile, Xu Youyu cheerfully took Ying Chanxi, had her grab her change of clothes and pajamas, and then pulled her into the bathroom. "Xixi, let me help you bathe today."

After showering, Li Luo began to write. During a break, he came out to get a popsicle. As he passed the bathroom in the living area, he heard some subtle sounds coming from inside.

"S-Senior Sister... you've been touching for a long time. You don't need to rub for that long..."

"Didn't you ask me why mine are so big? Just rub them more and it'll work."

"Really?"

"Of course not, you actually believed that? Xixi, you're too cute, haha!"

Hearing this conversation, some wonderful images instantly surfaced in Li Luo's mind.

Not daring to linger at the bathroom door, Li Luo quickly went into the kitchen, grabbed a popsicle, and hurried back to his bedroom.

After a whole hour of fussing, Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu finally emerged languidly from the steam-filled bathroom. Both of their cheeks were flushed, their faces glowing with a healthy, vibrant color.

It was just that one walked out openly, her blush simply from the steam, while the other's face was red with shyness.

If it weren't for her leg being inconvenient, Ying Chanxi would never dare to bathe with Xu Youyu again.

"Xixi, is there anything else you need help with?" Xu Youyu asked caringly after leaving the bathroom.

Ying Chanxi quickly shook her head. "Thank you, Senior Sister. You should get some sleep early too."

"Alright then, you be careful." Xu Youyu nodded and returned to her own bedroom.

Leaning on her crutch, Ying Chanxi watched Xu Youyu go back to her room, then slowly made her way to Li Luo's bedroom door, knocked, and then pushed it open.

When Li Luo saw her come in, he immediately gave up his seat for her and helped her blow-dry her hair.

"Are you really not going to tell your uncle?" Li Luo asked as he dried her hair. "You're injured, after all. You should at least let him know."

"It's fine," Ying Chanxi shook her head. "Dad is usually busy enough. It's not like it's a fracture or anything. It'll heal with some rest."

"Then you should stay home and rest well this weekend," Li Luo said. "After the sports meet ends tomorrow, I'll send you straight home. We won't go to Yan Zhusheng's place."

"Eh?" Ying Chanxi froze for a moment, then quickly asked, "What about you?"

"I have to record a song, so I definitely have to go," Li Luo said. "Tell Qiao Xinyan that you two won't be going this time. We'll go some other time."

"But..." Ying Chanxi's lips moved, not knowing how things had turned out this way. "It's not that serious. Can't we go together tomorrow?"

"Be good." Li Luo patted her head. "Even if I don't tell your dad, I have to tell my mom about your situation. Otherwise, if she finds out later, she'll kill me."

"I'll go to Yan Zhusheng's place tomorrow afternoon to record the song and be back before evening."

"Once my mom knows your situation, she'll definitely come over to cook for you and all that. Just stay at home and wait then."

Hearing Li Luo say all this, even bringing up Lin Xiuhong, Ying Chanxi puffed out her cheeks but finally gave in, nodding a little reluctantly. "Alright."

"You can ask Qiao Xinyan to come over to our place tomorrow. It'd be nice for her to hang out with you here," Li Luo added. "And ask her if she wants to have dinner here too."

"I know."

After her hair was dry, a dejected Ying Chanxi stood up, tossed the crutch aside, and held out her hands. "You take me back."

Li Luo said, "...You act so impressively like a class president at school, but your true colors show the moment you get home."

"None of your business. Hurry up."

Li Luo was helpless against her. He had no choice but to crouch down and lift her onto his back.

Even though their bedroom doors were less than a meter apart, Li Luo still carried her back, placed her on the bed, and then brought the crutch over.

"Be careful if you need to use the restroom at night."

"Oh."

"Then get some sleep early." Li Luo walked out of Ying Chanxi's bedroom. "Good night."

"Mm... good night."

Lying in bed, Ying Chanxi watched Li Luo close the door. She pursed her lips, pulled the Pikachu from the head of the bed over, and punched its head a few times with her little fists.

Still not feeling satisfied, she huffed and stuffed the Pikachu between her legs, squeezing it so it couldn't breathe.

As if that would vent her frustration.

But then she recalled the moment she fell on the track during the 100-meter finals this morning.

It was Yan Zhusheng who had appeared by her side first.

It was also Yan Zhusheng who had picked her up, coldly shooed away the crowding people, and carried her to the infirmary.

Zhusheng must truly see me as a good friend...

Including this Pikachu.

Thinking of this, Ying Chanxi couldn't help but purse her lips. She took the Pikachu out from under the blanket, gently stroked its head a few times, and whispered a few apologies.

Then, hugging the Pikachu, she fell into a deep sleep.

(End of Chapter)
